system.description: Action + 5 MP to enter. While in it, Defense and Magic Defense both become (9 + SL) — (10 + SL) at level 20+, (11 + SL) at 40+; the flat value replaces the score and nothing may be added to it. On leaving, choose one: a free attack with an equipped weapon, or a single-target spell costing (SL × 5) MP or less — High Roll treated as 0 either way.
